independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG2 scope. Its only authored files are QA tests and evidence (tests/qa/**, e2e/a20-bilingual-shell.spec.ts, e2e/support/qa-stack.sh, docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/**). In this round backend-workflow-engineer (T-DG2-BE9) changed two qa-verifier harness files, tests/qa/support/with-pg.sh and e2e/support/qa-stack.sh. qa-verifier reviewed that diff: it only adds initdb --encoding=UTF8 --locale=C, explicit ENCODING 'UTF8' TEMPLATE template0 databases and an encoding log line, and weakens nothing. Every result here comes from qa-verifier's own runs on a disposable clone of 96a3c293 under $TMPDIR. The verdict was formed without reading any other reviewer's round-5 record.

checks_run.procedure: Investigate the first-attempt failures. The first integration and QA-stack e2e attempts included two superseded qa-verifier artifacts that rounds 2-4 did not run: the round-1 suite dg2-qa-journey.test.ts (replaced by dg2-qa-journey-r2) and the round-3 inverse probe dg2-qa-blank-probe-r3.spec.ts (replaced by -probe-r4). Classify their failures by running the round-1 suite on the round-4 candidate (control).
checks_run.command: attempt 1: same commands as QA-R5-10/11 and QA-R5-17/18 with those files present; control: QA_PG_PORT=54981 tests/qa/support/with-pg.sh npx vitest run --project integration tests/qa/integration/dg2-qa-journey.test.ts in a clone @e37f6ea4
checks_run.environment: clones @96a3c293 and @e37f6ea4; node v24.21.0; disposable PostgreSQL 16.13 (UTF8)
checks_run.expected: any failure is confined to superseded QA artifacts and is identical on the round-4 candidate (not a regression)
checks_run.actual: Attempt 1, both locales: integration 524/526, with failures only in the round-1 suite: G2 lists g2.outcome_tree.thesis_incomplete and g2.kpi_definitions.not_active, because the suite predates KPI activation and the thesis rule, and G3 is then out of sequence. QA-stack e2e: 96 passed and 2 failed, only probe-r3, which asserts the pre-fix 'one PATCH sent' and now sees 0, the correct behaviour (as recorded in round 4). The control on e37f6ea4 fails identically: same missing lists, 2 failed and 1 passed. Classified as stale QA artifacts, not product regressions; they were excluded from the final runs QA-R5-10/11/17/18 as in rounds 2-4.

checks_run.procedure: Independent negative check (D-065), run in both locale settings. On a disposable UTF8 cluster, create databases with ENCODING 'SQL_ASCII' and 'LATIN1' (TEMPLATE template0). Run the built mth-db migrate, status, seed-dev and bootstrap against each, and list every non-system relation, schema, function and type before and after. Start the built API on the SQL_ASCII database and call /readyz twice. Control: a UTF8 database migrates, and /readyz reports ready.
checks_run.command: env -u LANG -u LC_ALL | env LANG=C.UTF-8: QA_ENC_PG_PORT=5543x QA_ENC_API_PORT=384x bash docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/tests/round-5/encoding-refusal.sh
checks_run.expected: every mth-db command exits 1 with 'mth-db: the database must use UTF8 encoding (found <ENC>)'; nothing created; /readyz 503 database fail; UTF8 control migrates and is ready
checks_run.actual: Both locales: 28/28 assertions PASS. SQL_ASCII and LATIN1: migrate, status, seed-dev and bootstrap each exit 1 with the exact refusal (found SQL_ASCII / found LATIN1). The object list is empty before and after, and there is no schema_migration table. /readyz on SQL_ASCII returns 503 {database: fail, migrations: fail} on both calls, and the API logs 'readiness: the database must use UTF8 encoding (found SQL_ASCII)'. Control qa_utf8: migrate applies 19, exit 0; /readyz returns 200 {database: ok, migrations: ok}.

summary: PASS. F-DG2-220 verifies CLOSED: 'pnpm test' passed 15 of 15 runs at 640/640 each (Node 24 8/8, Node 22 4/4, under CPU load 3/3), and the slowest p2-blank-forms test fell from 2121 ms to 411 ms. All static checks pass. Integration passes 523/523 in both locale settings (LANG/LC_ALL unset and LANG=C.UTF-8): 19 migrations, DB guards, contract (161 ops), blank-text and encoding. e2e passes 62/62 on the product stack and 96/96 on the QA acceptance stack in both locale settings, in EN and AR, including Define→G2 and Design→G3. Axe shows no serious or critical violation, error states included, and every database logs server_encoding UTF8. D-065 negative: SQL_ASCII and LATIN1 databases are refused by every mth-db command with exit 1, nothing is created, and /readyz reports database: fail. F-DG2-180: a variation selector alone, Default_Ignorable code points and C0 controls are refused in a charter field in EN and AR, in the UI and at the API, and emoji+VS16 is stored verbatim. Two first-attempt failures came from superseded qa-verifier artifacts and reproduce identically on the round-4 candidate; they are not regressions. No new findings. Environmental residuals D-057, D-058 and D-049 are recorded as PASS on the offline/config surface. All data is synthetic; no business approval is implied, and product G1–G6 never imply DG7.
